channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: Mix & Match Menu: $4.99 half sandwiches, salads or soups
item.guid: Panera Bread-Mix & Match Menu: $4.99 half sandwic-2026-09-09
item.description: Pick two or more half-size soups, salads or sandwiches (Toasted Italiano, Fuji Apple Chicken and more) for $4.99 each, plus a free side. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: Fresh Value Menu: $4.99 Sub of the Day, $3.99 Deli Faves & Protein Pockets
item.guid: Subway-Fresh Value Menu: $4.99 Sub of the Day, -2026-09-09
item.description: Subway's first-ever value menu offers a rotating $4.99 six-inch Sub of the Day plus $3.99 Deli Faves and Protein Pockets sandwiches nationwide. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Sub of the Day: $4.99 six-inch sub
item.guid: Subway-Sub of the Day: $4.99 six-inch sub-2026-09-09
item.description: A different six-inch sub is featured at $4.99 every day at participating restaurants, part of Subway's new Fresh Value Menu; add chips and a drink for $2 more. (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-09-09
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Sprouts: Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $5
item.guid: Sprouts-Sushi Wednesday: Select Oumi Rolls for $-2026-09-09
item.description: Every Wednesday in most Sprouts Farmers Market locations, select Oumi sushi rolls from the in-store sushi case are $5 each instead of the regular $7 to $10. Walk in and grab them: no coupon, app, or membership needed; participation and selection vary by store. (Select states only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Kroger: Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls, Typically $5
item.guid: Kroger-Sushi Wednesday: Snowfox Promo Rolls, Ty-2026-09-09
item.description: Every Wednesday, Kroger-family stores with a Snowfox or Zenshi sushi counter (Kroger, Fred Meyer, Fry's, King Soopers, Smith's, QFC, Ralphs) sell the Wednesday Only promo lineup, including spicy tuna, Philly, California and veggie rolls, at a flat promotional price, typically $5 (some divisions $6) versus $8 to $10 the rest of the week. Walk in; a free Kroger Plus card may be needed for the promo price. (Select states only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-09-09
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's biggest value menu yet: a full pita meal for $9.99, available in-store and on the app. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Rubio's Coastal Grill: $7+ Meal Menu, including new Fish & Chips for $7.99
item.guid: Rubio's Coastal Grill-$7+ Meal Menu, including new Fish & -2026-09-09
item.description: Rubio's standing value menu features meals from $7 to $10, headlined by the new Fish & Chips for just $7.99. (CA, AZ & NV only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: Delicious Duos: small entree, protein and a side from $9.95
item.guid: Noodles & Company-Delicious Duos: small entree, protein an-2026-09-09
item.description: Pair a small entree of any Noodles favorite with a protein and a side, served all day, starting at $9.95. (Ongoing)

item.title: WaBa Grill: Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and drink for $7.99
item.guid: WaBa Grill-Value-Bowl Combo: mini bowl, side and dr-2026-09-09
item.description: A permanent value menu item: a mini bowl with chicken, sweet and spicy chicken or tofu, plus a value side and 12 oz drink for $7.99. (CA & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Salad and Go: Salads and wraps from $7.75
item.guid: Salad and Go-Salads and wraps from $7.75-2026-09-09
item.description: Drive-thru-only salads and wraps, including the Good Greens Salad and Wrap with chickpeas, Brussels sprouts and choice of chicken or tofu, start at $7.75. (Arizona & Nevada only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-09-09
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Hy-Vee: Sushi Wednesday: Select Nori Sushi Rolls for $6
item.guid: Hy-Vee-Sushi Wednesday: Select Nori Sushi Rolls-2026-09-09
item.description: Every Wednesday at participating Hy-Vee stores with a Nori Sushi counter, select rolls are $6 each (regularly about $8 to $10). A store-run promotion: price and selection vary by store, and no card or app is needed. (Midwest only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: H-E-B: Sushi Wednesday: Select Sushiya Rolls for $7
item.guid: H-E-B-Sushi Wednesday: Select Sushiya Rolls fo-2026-09-09
item.description: Every Wednesday, H-E-B stores with an in-store Sushiya counter sell select fresh rolls for $7 (regularly about $9 to $12). No coupon or app needed; selection varies by store and sells out by evening. (Texas only) (Wednesdays only)

item.title: ShopRite: $5.99 Sushi Wednesday: Select Rolls
item.description: Every Wednesday, participating ShopRite stores sell select fresh sushi rolls (spicy crab, California and more) for $5.99, regularly $8 to $10. In-store only; ShopRite stores are independently owned, so selection and participation vary. (NJ, NY, PA, CT, DE & MD only) (Wednesdays only)
